blocks.html: Drop a two-point line on the map to get the exact distance and azimuth between a start and an end point — the basics for fires and recon callouts.

slides.title: Drop the Range&Bearing Line
slides.html: Open the Range Tools toolbar from Additional Tools & Plugins, then tap the R&B Line icon so it turns yellow. Tap your start point, then tap a second point to set the line.

slides.title: Read distance and azimuth
slides.html: The line label shows the azimuth and distance between the two points (for example, 68°M 12.21 km). The line stays put until you delete it.

slides.title: Reposition with a Dynamic R&B Line
slides.html: Use the Dynamic R&B Line instead to drag an endpoint and re-measure on the fly. When it is where you want it, tap the center of the line and use Pin to fix the line in place.

slides.title: Choose your bearing units
slides.html:
Tap an endpoint, then the Angle Bearing Units radial to switch how the azimuth is read. Pick the unit your fires net uses:

  • Degrees True / Mils True
  • Degrees Magnetic / Mils Magnetic
  • Degrees Grid / Mils Grid
